tactics_allowed.source:
SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors ta
  JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions ts ON ts.id=ta.session_id
  JOIN public.locations tactics_location ON tactics_location.id=ts.location_id
  JOIN combat_panel_private.multiplication_tactics_release_gate tactics_gate
    ON tactics_gate.singleton AND tactics_gate.version>=1
      AND tactics_gate.revision_reference='combat-multiplication-tactics/1'
  WHERE ta.id=p_actor AND ta.actor_kind IN ('pg','png') AND ta.companion_id IS NULL
    AND ta.state='attivo' AND ts.state='in_corso' AND ts.closed_at IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exam_regia_private.bindings eb WHERE eb.combat_session_id=ts.id)
    AND exam_regia_private.current_principal() IS NOT NULL
    AND exam_regia_private.actor_principal(ta.id,ta.controller_user)=exam_regia_private.current_principal()
    AND combat_panel_private.owner_turn_context(ta.id)->>'activity_kind' IN ('ordinary_v2','master_v2')
    AND (
     (
      tactics_gate.staff_enabled AND (
       combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(ts.location_id,ARRAY[exam_regia_private.current_principal()],false)
       OR (
        ta.actor_kind='png' AND ta.controller_user IS NULL AND ta.character_id IS NULL
        AND ta.companion_id IS NULL AND ts.source_kind='master'
        AND ts.master_session_id IS NOT NULL AND ts.lesiva IS FALSE
        AND auth.uid() IS NULL AND public.combat_v2_is_service()
        AND mission_generic_owner.current_principal()=exam_regia_private.current_principal()
        AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_permits tactics_permit
          JOIN public.master_v2_sessions tactics_master ON tactics_master.id=tactics_permit.master_session_id
          WHERE tactics_permit.actor_id=ta.id AND tactics_permit.encounter_id=ts.id
            AND tactics_permit.master_session_id=ts.master_session_id
            AND tactics_permit.principal_id=exam_regia_private.current_principal()
            AND tactics_permit.transaction_id=txid_current() AND tactics_permit.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
            AND tactics_permit.consumed_at IS NULL
            AND tactics_permit.created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '150 seconds'
            AND tactics_master.owner_kind='ai_service' AND tactics_master.master_user IS NULL
            AND tactics_master.closed_at IS NULL AND tactics_master.location_id=ts.location_id
        )
        AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors tactics_staff_actor
          WHERE tactics_staff_actor.session_id=ts.id AND tactics_staff_actor.actor_kind='pg'
            AND tactics_staff_actor.state='attivo'
            AND combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(ts.location_id,
              ARRAY[exam_regia_private.actor_principal(tactics_staff_actor.id,tactics_staff_actor.controller_user)],false)
        )
       )
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors other_actor
        WHERE other_actor.session_id=ta.session_id AND other_actor.actor_kind='pg'
          AND NOT combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(ts.location_id,
            ARRAY[exam_regia_private.actor_principal(other_actor.id,other_actor.controller_user)],false))
     )
     OR CASE WHEN tactics_location.is_active AND NOT tactics_location.is_test
       AND NOT tactics_location.is_exam_room THEN (
      (
       auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (
        (ta.actor_kind='pg' AND tactics_gate.ordinary_enabled
          AND combat_panel_private.owner_turn_context(ta.id)->>'activity_kind'='ordinary_v2')
        OR (tactics_gate.master_enabled
          AND combat_panel_private.owner_turn_context(ta.id)->>'activity_kind'='master_v2'
          AND EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions tactics_public_master
            WHERE tactics_public_master.id=ts.master_session_id
              AND tactics_public_master.location_id=ts.location_id
              AND tactics_public_master.closed_at IS NULL
              AND (
                (tactics_public_master.owner_kind='human' AND tactics_public_master.master_user IS NOT NULL)
                OR (tactics_public_master.owner_kind='ai_service' AND tactics_public_master.master_user IS NULL
        AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.session_admissions_v1 tactics_admission
          JOIN mission_public_owner.publications_v2 tactics_current_pub
            ON tactics_current_pub.request_key=tactics_admission.publication_request
            AND tactics_current_pub.mission_id=tactics_admission.mission_id
            AND tactics_current_pub.source_mission_id=tactics_admission.mission_id
            AND tactics_current_pub.config_version=tactics_admission.capability_version
            AND tactics_current_pub.target='public' AND tactics_current_pub.visibility='open'
            AND tactics_current_pub.state='open'
          WHERE tactics_admission.master_session_id=ts.master_session_id
            AND tactics_admission.location_id=ts.location_id AND tactics_admission.mode='ai'
            AND tactics_admission.publication_request IS NOT NULL
            AND mission_public_owner.role_session_allowed_v1(ts.master_session_id)
            AND mission_public_owner.c1266_regia_public_scope_v1(
              tactics_admission.mission_id,'ai',tactics_admission.publication_request,
              tactics_current_pub.release_revision_sha256)
        )
                )
              )
          )
        )
       )
      )
      OR CASE WHEN tactics_gate.generic_enabled THEN (
        ta.actor_kind='png' AND ta.controller_user IS NULL AND ta.character_id IS NULL
        AND ta.companion_id IS NULL AND ts.source_kind='master'
        AND ts.master_session_id IS NOT NULL AND ts.lesiva IS FALSE
        AND auth.uid() IS NULL AND public.combat_v2_is_service()
        AND mission_generic_owner.current_principal()=exam_regia_private.current_principal()
        AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_permits tactics_permit
          JOIN public.master_v2_sessions tactics_master ON tactics_master.id=tactics_permit.master_session_id
          WHERE tactics_permit.actor_id=ta.id AND tactics_permit.encounter_id=ts.id
            AND tactics_permit.master_session_id=ts.master_session_id
            AND tactics_permit.principal_id=exam_regia_private.current_principal()
            AND tactics_permit.transaction_id=txid_current() AND tactics_permit.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
            AND tactics_permit.consumed_at IS NULL
            AND tactics_permit.created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '150 seconds'
            AND tactics_master.owner_kind='ai_service' AND tactics_master.master_user IS NULL
            AND tactics_master.closed_at IS NULL AND tactics_master.location_id=ts.location_id
        )
        AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.session_admissions_v1 tactics_admission
          JOIN mission_public_owner.publications_v2 tactics_current_pub
            ON tactics_current_pub.request_key=tactics_admission.publication_request
            AND tactics_current_pub.mission_id=tactics_admission.mission_id
            AND tactics_current_pub.source_mission_id=tactics_admission.mission_id
            AND tactics_current_pub.config_version=tactics_admission.capability_version
            AND tactics_current_pub.target='public' AND tactics_current_pub.visibility='open'
            AND tactics_current_pub.state='open'
          WHERE tactics_admission.master_session_id=ts.master_session_id
            AND tactics_admission.location_id=ts.location_id AND tactics_admission.mode='ai'
            AND tactics_admission.publication_request IS NOT NULL
            AND mission_public_owner.role_session_allowed_v1(ts.master_session_id)
            AND mission_public_owner.c1266_regia_public_scope_v1(
              tactics_admission.mission_id,'ai',tactics_admission.publication_request,
              tactics_current_pub.release_revision_sha256)
        )
      ) ELSE false END
     ) ELSE false END
    ))
